top_signals.title: Why Canadian Oil Is Lagging Even As Global Crude Soars
top_signals.summary: The oil price rally resumed its upward trajectory on Friday after the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) confirmed the sinking of the Singapore-flagged container ship following an Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) projectile strike in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude for December delivery jumped 3.33% to trade at $109.50 per barrel at 2.35 pm ET, while WTI crude for November delivery was up 3.41% to change hands at $101.30/bbl, marking the first time the American benchmark has traded above $100/bbl in a month. top_signals.title: US Airlines Plan 4Q Capacity Growth in Key Markets
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Aerospace, Defense, & Airlines Analyst, George Ferguson discusses the outlook for US airlines as they aim to boost capacity into Q4. He also looks ahead to SpaceX earnings this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
